points: After 23 years of prophecy, Yirmiyahu says: I spoke to you again and again, and you didn't listen. The message was always the same: change your bad ways.
Nevuchadnetzar has just become king of a small country, and Yirmiyahu says Bavel will become a superpower and conquer Mitzrayim, the Pelishtim, Edom, Moav, Ammon and more.
In a vision, he makes all the nations drink a cup of wine: they'll be like drunks, helpless before Bavel.
The Malbim: "Ein puranios ba'ah la'olam ela bishvil Yisrael." Bad things in the world come because of us. It's not about pointing fingers at others; it's a call for us to change.
"Hashem mimarom yishag": Chazal in Berachos explain Hashem's roar is not an attack but a cry of pain: woe to Me that My children are in exile. Hashem feels our pain.
